status_boundary: These are Gil Marer's allegations and evidential hypotheses. No page declares criminal guilt or substitutes for a competent judicial determination.

chain.facts: Community route sought incorporation of the full accommodation perimeter; Cabildo required procedure-specific authority, unit/finca identification, own-unit deeds and owner-issued enabling title for remaining units; Yaiza issued an adverse definitive compatibility report.
chain.criminal_question: Who asserted authority over which units, what independent title supported it, what was known after the requirements/adverse report, and where was the same authority proposition later reused?

chain.facts: HNT advanced a holder/property/exploitation route; Cabildo recorded the existing 1-star / 159 / 477 position and required sufficient property title/classification material.
chain.criminal_question: Was any later representation of complete property/availability knowingly made before the title requirement was satisfied, and what effect did it seek?

chain.configuration: HNT / MYND holder-name change at 1 star / 159 / 477
chain.facts: RGT entry 2023-T15093 dated 18 October 2023 records Hotel New Trend, S.L. and MYND Yaiza while preserving the then-recorded category/capacity.
chain.criminal_question: Was this limited administrative effect later presented as proof of wider title, authority or capacity that the act itself did not establish?

chain.facts: HNT project/responsible-declaration route was followed by Cabildo toma de conocimiento; the act is treated as an enabling/provisional procedural effect rather than final technical verification.
chain.criminal_question: Which underlying representations were repeated, what verification remained outstanding, and what later public/investor/funding use was made of the resulting administrative posture?

chain.configuration: start/activity route; earlier 3671 and 2984 expressly pending
chain.facts: The executive record states 3671/2022 and 2984/2023 were pending/related; February 2025 communications state a verification visit and corresponding resolution remained to be performed.
chain.criminal_question: If later actors represented the relevant title/authority/configuration as conclusively regularised, who knew these pending checkpoints, what was said, to whom, and with what effect?

chain.configuration: applicant-declared 4 star / 301 units / 299 operating / 660 places / 598 operating
chain.facts: The configuration is treated as applicant-declared/requested unless and until a later Cabildo verification/final act is sourced.
chain.criminal_question: What title/authority basis supported the enlarged perimeter, and was the declared status knowingly used elsewhere as if it were finally verified?

criminal_routes.label: Falsedad documental / uso
criminal_routes.test: alteration/simulation or knowing use of a false public, official, mercantile or private document; exact article depends on author/document/use

criminal_routes.label: Estafa / estafa procesal
criminal_routes.test: sufficient deception + error + disposition/effect + patrimonial prejudice + profit motive; procedural use must be proved, not inferred from inconsistency

criminal_routes.label: Administración desleal
criminal_routes.test: entrusted management power + excess/breach + patrimonial harm

criminal_routes.label: Frustración de la ejecución
criminal_routes.test: asset disposition/obligation designed to prejudice creditors or impede foreseeable enforcement

criminal_routes.label: Insolvencia punible
criminal_routes.test: specific insolvency conduct affecting assets/creditors; not every insolvency irregularity is criminal

criminal_routes.label: Organización / grupo criminal
criminal_routes.test: more than multiple actors: stable/coordinated division of functions for committing crimes must be proved actor by actor

criminal_routes.label: Deber de denuncia / omisión pública
criminal_routes.test: professional/office reporting duty and, for CP 408, intentional failure by authority/public official to promote prosecution of known offences

procedural_sources.label: 2023 Audiencia Nacional querella
procedural_sources.status: alleged coacciones, usurpación, estafa/estafa procesal, administración desleal, falsedad, investment/publicity fraud and other offences; pleading is not proof
